tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i snying po stan thog gcig ma'i khrid yig bzhugs/

na mo gu ru buddhā bo dhi satwa bhyaḥ 'dir rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i snying po stan thog gcig tu gril nas bsgom pa'i tshul 'di ltar bya ste/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la ci mdzad khyed rang shes so snyam pa'i blos 'gel gyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par 'dod pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la mos gus gdung shugs drag po dung dung pa zhig kyang bya/ de nas sor sdud ni/ mun khang dngos sam rjes mthun pa zhig tu rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa khu tshur brla bzhagasgal tshigs drang por bsrang*/ ro stod sgyed/ mgrin pa cung zad dgugalce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig ha cang ma phye/ ha cang ma btsum pa'i ngang nas/ gtsug tor du lta ba'i tshul gyis lta stangs gyen du bzlog /rlung ro lan gsum bsal la/ dbugs rang babs su bzhag sems dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa thams cad spangs te/ lta stangs gang du gtad pa'i nam mkha' nag thing nge ba de la sems mi 'phro ba'i rten tsam byas te/ ha cang mi bsgrims/ ha cang mi glod par bzo med du shig ge mnyam par bzhag ste/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ / sprin dang bser bu med cing nam mkha' dwangs pa'i skabs/ lus dang mig la nyi 'od mi 'phog par byas/ mig shin tu gdangs te nam mkha' sngo bsang nge ba la lta zhing*/ gzhan bsgom tshul sngar dang 'dra bar bya ste/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de ltar nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gnyis gcig tu gril te bsgoms pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu mngon du 'gyur te/ de ltar yang sems pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /dbang po thams cad bzlog par bya/ /dgon pa dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /mig dag steng du bzlog nas ni/ /smin ma'i dbus su sems byas na/ /mi bzad mun pa lta bur ni/ /sgrub pos dang por mthong bar 'gyur/

/zhes ṛ gi a rall̥ las so/ /de nas bsam gtan bsgom par bya ste/ so sor sdud pa'i rnal 'byor dang mtshungs pa las/ ji ltar mthong ba'i stong gzugs kyi snang ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i lta stangs nyid g.yo ba med par blta zhing sems kyang gzugs brnyan de la che re gtad/ blos byas kyi bzo bcos mi byed/ stong gzugs de kha'i rang zhal la rig ge bltas pas/ snang ba ma 'gags shing*/ yul dus rang bzhin 'di lta bu zhes brjod du med cing spros pa dang bral ba de ngos zin zhing rig par bya/ de ni shes rab kyi yan lag yin zhing*/ de las rtags snang rang sems su myong ba'i rtog pa dang*/ de nyid mtshan ma dang bral bar rig pa'i dpyod pa dang*/ lus sems la dga' bde dang*/ yul dang yul can dbyer med du 'dres pa'i bde ba shin tu sbyangs pa ste yan lag lnga po de dag rim gyis skye bar 'gyur ro/ /stong gzugs la bstan pa ma thob na mnyam bzhag tu sor sdud nyid bsgom zhing*/ thun mtshams su byed bcings phal cher phyogs 'dra bar byas nas/ tha mal las snang gi steng du cher re lta zhing*/ de'i rang bzhin gsal la ngos bzung med pa de rang ngo shes tsam byas te bskyangs/ mnyam rjes de gnyis gom pa las bsam gtan gyi yan lag 'phral tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang*/ gsang ba gsum 'byung rtog pa ste/ /de yi longs spyod dpyod pa'o/ /dga' dang 'dra ba gsum pa ste/ /bde bas bsdus pa bzhi pa'o/ /shes dang shes bya byung zad pa'i/ /rang sems lnga par shes par bya/ /zhes 'dus pa phyi ma las so/ /srog rtsol gyi yan lag ni/ lus kyi byed bcings gzhan dang 'dra ba la lta stangs bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lta ba ste/ smin mtshams kyi thad kar hrig ge lta ba yin/ ngag gi gnad rlung ro dgu phrugs su bus la/ rlung phyir cung zad cig bzung ba'i skabs/ 'og sgo bsdam la thur sel lte ba tsam du shug drag par 'then/

steng rlung oṃ gyi sgrar mos pa dang bcas te shar gyis drangs la lte bar bsgyur thabs su mnan/ 'og rlung drag tu drangs/ cung zad mi bde na slar yang rngub chung byas te/ 'then gnon bya/ de dag gi bar du rlung gnas pa hūṃ gi gdangs su mos/ de nas dal bus phra la ring ba'i shugs kyis phyir btang ste āḥyig gi gdangs su mos pa bya'o/ /tshul de yang nas yang du gom par bya ba las/ sems kyi gnad ni yi ge 'bru gsum gyi gdangs su mos pa yud tsam res chog la/ gtso bor rlung 'jug gnas ldang gsum thams cad la stong gzugs dang rlung gi reg bya nyams su myong ba'i shes pa gcig nyid rang gi rig pa'i tshul gyis mnyam par 'jog ste/ cung zad goms na rlung phyir 'gro ba'i skabs stong gzugs nyid la bsgrim pa'i tshul gyis bsgom/ nang du yong ba'i skabs gzugs snang nyid sems kyi ngo bor myong bar byas nas sems nyid la mnyam par bzhag /gnas pa'i skabs rlung dang stong gzugs sems gsum la cha mnyam du mnyam par bzhag pa las/ myong ba po 'am/ tshor ba po 'am/ rig pa po 'am/ mthong ba po dbyings su yal ba de la 'bad rtsol med par bzhag go /de ltar yang*/ bdag nyid rig pas rkang mthil bar/ / thams cad rlung gis kun bkang ste/ /bum pa can la brten byas nas/ /bya ba gsum gyis gzhom par bshad/ /ces sdom pa 'byung ba las so/ /thun mtshams su sems rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ ngag bum pa can gyi ngang nas/ mgo bo dang*/ lag pa dang*/ rkang pa dang*/ khong stod dang*/ khong smad rnams lag len bzhin phur mnye mang du bya/ mgo bo bskor zhing 'phang*/ ro stod gcu/ rgya mtsho bskyod/ zhags pa 'phang*/ lag pa g.yab/ rkang pa brkyang bskum dang 'then zhing brdung*/ （《dzaṃ》+rkang pa nas lus thams cad） rgyab 'phar bya/ skyil krung bteg cing rdeb/ de nyid yang dang yang du bya ba las/ dang por dal bu dal bus bya/ phyis drag cing shugs che bar bya/

gzhan yang ha ring ha thung dang 'bebs che chung yang ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de nas 'dzin pa'i yan lag ni/ srog rtsol de nyid la brten nas shugs la skye ba yin te/ 'on kyang lte bar grub zin nas snying ga dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba dang gtsug tor rnams su bum can ma grub pa grub pa'i phyir dang*/ lte ba sogs lnga char du grub nas rlung sems dbu ma'i thig ler 'ching ba'i phyir dang*/ 'chings nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir sgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /yan lag 'di gnyis kyi bogs 'don du hūṃ ring drag pos thur sel gyen du drangs shing*/ hūṃ thung gi steng rlung brngubs nas kyang thur sel 'dren pa <gcig la gcig bstud kyi/> bstud mar lan mang du bsgom <pa'i mthar rlung 'bud do/ /de'i 'dug steng ni 'di yin te > lus gnad 'phong stegs btsud la tsog pu bya/ lag pa brla nang nas rgyud rkang pa'i ngar gdong nas 'then pa'o/ /yang rlung phyir bzung ba'i ngang nas hūṃ ring gis drangs te/ 'og sgo gnyis su re mos kyi drag tu bsdigs /yang <rlung > phyir bus nas kyang 'og sgo gnyis su shugs yang yang bcug go /'di la lus gnad sngar dang mtshungs pa'am/ <yang na > sgyid pa gnyis par lhu <ste dpung pa > la bkal te/ lag pa'i shugs kyis byin pa gnyis gyen la 'degs/ 'di gnyis ka la ma ning gi rlung shugs bskyed pa'i ngang nas/ 'og sgo brdams klod drag po mang du byed pa dang*/ <de nas > steng rlung kha dang sna re mos nas rngub ste mgrin par ming nas lte bar 'phul ba dang*/ <yar > sgregs pa 'don pa yang yang bya'o/ /yang de rnams <la > rkang rtse sa la btsugs/ dpus mo gshog pa ltar brkyangs/ lag pa <g.yas > mdun <dang g.yon > rgyab tu brkyang bas kyang rung ngo*/ /rlung sbyor gsum po 'di ni hūṃ phaṭa sbyor ba'i man ngag dang dgos pa gcig pa las/ 'di shin tu rno ste g.yas g.yon srog thur mtha' dga' bsre

ba'o/ /thun mtshams su sngar bzhin lus sbyong la 'bad/ de ltar na/ g.yas g.yon dang steng 'og gi rlung ro gcig tu bsre ba ni srog rtsol yin la/ de nyid dbu mar thim par byed pa ni 'dzin pa'o/ /'dzin pa 'di las bde drod kyi nyams dang*/ gzhom med kyi sgra dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi snang brnyan rab 'byams 'byung ste/ de ltar yang*/ chos 'byung las skyes ye shes ni/ /mkha' mnyam lhan cig thabs dang bcas/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin la/ /'jig rten gsum po de las skyes/ /zhes dgyes ba rdo rje las so/ /rjes dran ni/ bdag nyid dus 'khor bde dgyes gshin rje gshed la sogs pa/ lhag pa'i lha yab tu gsal ba stong gzugs dang ro gcig tu gsal bar byas/ las sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya gang yin yang rung ste/ <'on kyang ye shes phyag rgya dus 'khor yab yum tu gsal ba'i > de la'ang stong gzugs kyis rgyas btab <phan tshun 'khyud pa la sogs pa'i > rjes chags kyi spyod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dbang po gny-is mnyam par sbyar zhing*/ <de nas lte ba'i bum pa can gyi sbyor ba dang ldan pas/> de las dga' ba bzhi ngang gis skye bar 'gyur la/ <spyi bo nas rtsa 'khor > re re bzhin bzung bzlog khyab <dmigs > pa'i gnad re tshang bar byas nas/ byang chub kyi sems gsang ba'am nor bur 'ongs pa na/ srog <steng rlung > phyir bsal zhing*/ thur sel drag tu <mar > glod pas <gsang > rtsa ltem par 'gyur zhing*/ ma ning gi rlung shugs dang ldan pas rlung <gyen du > bzlog par 'gyur la/ de nyid mar yang yang <gnon pa'i > nang gi gtun brdung gi sbyor bas rba rlabs zhi bar 'gyur te/ de ltar lus ngag 'dres pa'i gnad gsum dang*/ sems stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag pa'i gnad de/ gnad bzhi ldan gyis 'pho med du bzung*/ srog la longs spyod kyi rlabs <'khrul 'khor sogs > gzhan gyis dgag pa dang*/ thur sel la dbu ma'i lam

<ste nang thig le dang rlung sems rnams brtan pa la/> bdag nyid kyis dgag pa'ang bshad do/ /de nas nang gi <re steng rlung > hūṃ sbyor dang thur sel bsnol ma khong sgra dang bcas pa dang*/ stobs kyi hūṃ drag po rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems 'khor lo drug tu yang bzlog par bya'o/ / <rtsa 'khor > de dag re re bzhin gyi mthar yang lus gyi gnas rnams drag tu gcud cing sprugs pas khyab par bya/ de ltar gnad gsum lan ci rigs par sbyangs nas/ mthar 'di ltar bya ste/ <rting pa gnyis phyag rgyar bsnol ba/> tsog pu 'phongs stegs cung zad bcas/ lag pa gnyis mdun du btsugs la/ 'og rlung bsnol ma shugs bskyed pa lan dgu bya/ dmigs pa nor bu la gtad/ mthar lus thams cad gcu zhing drag tu sprugs la mjug tu lan gsum brdeb/ yang <'dug stangs > de nyid las srog rlung drag tu phyir bsal/ <rjes > thur sel <gyi rlung > g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du <yar > 'then zhing*/ lto ba <phyir > 'gyur ba lan drug bya/ dmigs pa gsang ba dang lte ba la gtad/ drug po re re'i mthar yang gcud sprugs rdeb pa gsum gong bzhin <lan re > byed/ <phar gcig 'phror gcig > de nas lag pa stod <du > skyil <krung > bcas nas/ <srog thur gyi rlung > kha sbyor stod du drang pa lan gsum/ dmigs pa snying ga dang mgrin par gtad/ re re'i mthar yang gcud sprugs rdeb pa sngar bzhin bya/ de nas lag pa brkyangs/ sor mo phral te bstan/ gdong g.yas g.yon du bsgyur/ ltag pa bsrang ste mgo dgugalag pa dang lag sor la'ang shed bcugasrog thur rang 'gags las ma ning gi shugs steng du drag tu drangs/ dmigs pa dpral ba dang spyi bor gtad de lan gcig go /gcud sbrags rdeb pa gong bzhin bya/ de nas bum can dang ma ning sprugs pa'i ngang nas rkang pa dang*/ rkang sor brkyang bskum <rkang rtse > bcud pa lan dgu dang bcas te 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum drag tu bya/

sprug pa rdeb pa mang du byed/ lag pa gnyis phyi nang gnyis nas <brgyud3gt; ngar gdong nas 'jus te/ <rlung bzung > stod smad g.yas g.yon thams cad drag tu bsrubs/ <de ma thag > de nas spro na seng ge rnam rol yang byed cing*/ mthar 'bebs chung dang/ te te brdung ba mang du bya/ de dag gi mthar lus gnad lta stangs bcas te bum pa can lan bdun tsam gyis rlung dang bsre/ sems 'od gsal stong gzugs la mi g.yo gsum ldan gyi sgo nas mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar yang*/ byed pa bcing pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa gsum po ni bsgrub par bya/ /zhes rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud las so/ /'di gnad du song na stong gzugs dang sems gnas la/ de ma thag tu bogs 'byin par 'gyur ro// rjes dran gyi man ngag bsdus pa 'di ni yan lag snga ma rnams kyi spogs chog dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gsal bar gsungs pa/ btsan thabs nā da'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba de nyid dngos yin la/ rjes dran gyi sgrub pa'am rgyu ches zab pa ste thug phrad du don ston pa yin no/ /de dag la nyams gang skyes byung rgyal du legs par bskyangs pas/ gegs dang gol sa thams cad las rang grol te/ yon tan thams cad gong 'phel tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin ni da lta las dang po pas ni mos sgom du bya ba tsam yin la/ de'i rang bzhin ni 'di lta ste/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mos zhu bde yang yang drangs pa na/ mi ring bar mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhes bya ba/ 'dod chags chen po thig le'i 'gros las shar ba'i lhan cig skyes pa dang stong gzugs ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa ste/ zung 'jug de'i ngo bo la dbye ba med kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i rtogs tshul la las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gags pa'i dbye bas <bde ba3gt; mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yang de snyed du 'gyur zhing*/ 'khor lo drug tu rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'gags pa'i sa bcu gnyis kyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba dang*/

rdul gyi dwangs ma gtsug tor nas nor bu'i bar du cha bcu gnyis su brtan par gyur pas/ bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid dang*/ dkar po snying stobs kyi dwangs ma nor bu nas spyi bo'i bar du dga' ba bcu drug gi rim pas brtan pa'i phyir/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug mngon du 'gyur te/ rlung dag pas ni thogs bcas rnams gnas 'gyur bar byed/ rtsa khams dag pas kyang rlung gnas gyur par byed/ dkar po dag pas sha khrag la sogs pa sbyong bar byed/ dmar po dag pas rus pa dang rkang sogs sbyong bar byed do/ /de ltar na snying stobs te khu ba dag pas 'khor ba'i lus spangs nas sku rdo rje'i gral du chud/ rdul te dmar cha dag pas 'khor ba'i dag spangs nas gsung rdo rje'i gral du chud/ mun pa ste rlung gi khams dag pas 'khor ba'i yid spangs nas thugs rdo rje'i gral du chud/ brten pa sems nyon mongs pa'i rnam rtog can de 'gags pas/ bzhi pa'i gnas skabs 'dzag bde dag nas/ sems nyid ye shes rdo rje'i gral du chud/ de ltar rdo rje bzhi dbyer mi phyed ba'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chung ngu'i gnas thob pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes tha snyad gdags so/ /de ltar yang*/ yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa yis/ /dus sbyor rnams ni mi 'bab phyir/ /sa rnams bcu gnyis zhes bya ba/ /gnas la sogs pa don dam pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur skad cig ni/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ /drug brgya yongs rdzogs rgyal po che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid 'gyur/ /zhes dang po'i sangs rgyas rtsa ba'i rgyud las so/ /de nas kun tu 'od kyi sa dang*/ bdud rtsi'i 'od dang*/ nam mkha'i 'od dang*/ rdo rje'i 'od dang*/ rin chen 'od dang*/ padma'i 'od dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi las byed pa'i sa dang*/ dpe med pa'i sa dang*/ dpe thams cad pa'i sa dang*/ shes rab 'od kyi sa dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa dang*/

so so'i bdag nyid rig pa'i sa ste sa bcu gnyis su rnam par bzhag pa rnams bgrod nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po srid pa'i bdag po/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rab 'byams mtha' yas pa/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i khams gsum gyi dbang phyug dam pa thob pa yin no/ /so sor nyams myong cung zad skyes nas/ thun gcig la srog rtsol gyi mthar bogs 'don rjes dran dang bcas pa bsgom/ thun gsum sor bsam bsgom pa dang*/ yang na thun gnyis srog rtsol dang thun gnyis sor sdud bsgom pa sogs bya'o/ /de ltar zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag snying po las kyang snying por gyur pa/ gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba/ zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i yi ge bla ma'i zhal lung ma sbas shing shin tu gsal bar bstan pa 'di ni/ zab don nyams len lhur byed pa rnams la nye bar mkho bar mthong nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas ri khrod chen po jo nang du nges par brjod pa'o/ /dar rgyas 'phel/ rang lugs kyi nyams khrid ma thob pa la gsang zhing sba bar bya'o// //rgyas gdab yin/ dge'o/ /zhus dag go /maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i snying po stan thog gcig ma'i khrid yig bzhugs/ -PAGE 254--PAGE 253--PAGE 252-
